paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Constraint from analysis of 39 Galactic Globular Clusters using measured R parameter (ratio of stars in horizontal branch to red giant branch) combined with state-of-the-art stellar models. Main result: gaγ < 0.66 × 10^-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL (Eq. 3, also stated in abstract). Represents flat horizontal limit across mass range ~10^-10 eV to ~10 keV where Primakoff process dominates. Significantly improves previous globular cluster bound of gaγ ≲ 10^-10 GeV^-1 (Raffelt & Dearborn 1987). Helium mass fraction uncertainty was largest systematic effect, accounted for using recent HII region measurements. Figure 1 shows full derivation; Table I summarizes bounds under different helium abundance scenarios (low-Z regions, SBBN, solar).
